ribbon.label: Ribbon

ribbon.formatOnly.docx: These tools apply to DOCX documents only.
command.unavailable.notImplemented: {command}: this command is not connected yet.
command.unavailable.engineUnsupported: {command}: not supported for this document format.
command.unavailable.notReady: {command}: the document cannot be edited right now (loading, closing, …).
command.unavailable.composing: {command}: finish composing the current input first.
command.unavailable.pendingEdits: {command}: earlier edits are still being applied. Try again in a moment.
command.unavailable.protected: {command}: not allowed because this document is protected (restricted editing).
command.unavailable.dialogOpen: {command}: close the dialog first, then try again.
command.reason.engineUnsupported: Not supported for this document format
command.about.message: geul {version} — UI layout stage. Opening, editing, and saving documents are not supported yet.
navigation.label: Navigation pane
navigation.title: Navigation
navigation.empty: Headings and pages appear here when a document is open.
properties.label: Properties pane
properties.title: Properties
properties.formatsNote: HWP/HWPX (rhwp editing PoC, T007) and DOCX (WordCraft editing PoC, T008) can be opened and edited; saving is still blocked for every format.
editor.label: Document editing area
editor.emptyBody: HWP/HWPX (rhwp, T007 PoC) and DOCX (WordCraft, T008 PoC) documents can be opened for editing with the path field above. Saving in any format is not connected yet.
status.label: Status bar
settings.saveFailed: Settings could not be saved. Changes apply to this session only.
settings.restore.recovered: Some saved settings were adjusted or restored to defaults.
settings.restore.malformed: Saved settings could not be read, so defaults are used.
settings.restore.unsupported: Saved settings use a newer format and were left unchanged. Changes apply to this session only.
settings.restore.unreadable: Settings storage could not be accessed, so defaults are used. Changes apply to this session only.
settings.conflict: Saved settings were changed elsewhere and were left unchanged. Changes apply to this session only.
editor.rhwp.idle: Not loaded into the engine yet
editor.rhwp.ready: Editable (rhwp PoC). Only documents that pass the preservation check are saved, in their original format.
editor.rhwp.failedUnpreserved: Edits made in this document were not saved and cannot be recovered. Reloading discards them.
editor.rhwp.failedUncertain: The editing engine failed during a change, so the document model may have been only partially changed. It may differ from what was shown; reloading discards this model.
editor.rhwp.renderLimit: This document's pages cannot be drawn at the current zoom ({zoom}%) within the display memory limit. Lower the zoom to continue editing. Your edits are kept.
editor.rhwp.renderLimitMinimum: This document's pages cannot be drawn at the current zoom ({zoom}%) within the display memory limit, not even at the smallest supported zoom. Your edits are kept, but editing cannot continue on this display.
editor.docx.idle: Not loaded into the engine yet
editor.docx.ready: Editable (WordCraft PoC). Only documents that pass the preservation check are saved, in their original format.
editor.docx.failedUnpreserved: Edits in this document were not saved and cannot be recovered. Reloading discards them.
editor.docx.renderLimit: At the current zoom of {zoom}% this document's pages cannot be drawn (screen memory limit). Lower the zoom to continue editing. Your edits are kept.
editor.docx.renderLimitMinimum: At the current zoom of {zoom}% this document's pages cannot be drawn (screen memory limit), not even at the smallest supported zoom. Your edits are kept, but this document cannot be displayed.
editor.docx.renderFailed: Page {pages} could not be drawn. The image shown may not be the current document, so editing is paused. Your edits are kept.
editor.docx.pasteUnsupported: The pasted text contains characters that cannot be inserted (such as control characters), so nothing was inserted. The document is unchanged.
editor.docx.pasteTooLarge: The pasted text exceeds the amount that can be inserted at once (1,048,576 characters), so nothing was inserted. The document is unchanged.
editor.docx.pasteIncomplete: The engine refused part of the pasted text, so only the beginning was inserted. The rest is not in the document.
editor.docx.commandRejected: The engine refused the command (for example, in a part of a protected document that cannot be edited). The document is unchanged.
editor.save.checking: Checking whether this document can be saved in its original format…
editor.save.changedSince: Edits made after saving are not saved yet.
editor.save.notDurable: The file was replaced with the new content, but the write to disk (directory sync) could not be confirmed, so the edits are kept as unsaved. Save again.
editor.save.safe: Preservation check passed; this document can be saved in its original format.
editor.save.originalKept: The original file was not changed.
editor.save.outcome.unsafe: Saving with this engine would change or drop part of the original.
editor.save.outcome.unknown: There is no evidence that the original would be preserved.
editor.save.unsupported.platform: Atomic replacement of the original has not been verified on this operating system yet.
editor.save.unsupported.hard-link: This file has other names (hard links) that would keep pointing to the old content.
editor.save.unsupported.ownership: The file has a different owner, which replacing it would change.
editor.save.unsupported.read-only: The original file is read-only, so it is not replaced.
editor.save.unsupported.metadata: The file's extended attributes, access control lists (ACLs) or file flags cannot be kept on the new file or cannot be verified, so it is not replaced.
editor.save.unsupported.shared-file: Other users (group or others) can write this file, so the verified content cannot be guaranteed to stay unchanged; it is not replaced.
editor.save.unsupported.shared-directory: Other users can change the folder that holds this file (group or other write, another owner, or an access control list), so the verified file cannot be guaranteed to be the one published; it is not replaced.
editor.save.stage.export: The engine could not export the document.
editor.save.stage.validate: The exported document could not be validated.
editor.save.stage.write: The temporary file could not be written or verified.
editor.save.stage.publish: The original could not be replaced.
editor.save.notReady.pending: Edits are still being applied. Try saving again shortly.
editor.save.notReady.composing: Finish the text being composed before saving.
editor.save.notReady.uncertain: The editing engine failed during a change, so the model is not trusted and will not be saved.
editor.save.notReady.state: The document cannot be saved right now.
editor.save.finding.partAdded: {part}: would be added (not in the original).
editor.save.finding.originalMalformed: {part}: the original cannot be read completely (damaged or truncated).
editor.save.finding.outputMalformed: {part}: the engine output is not valid.
editor.save.finding.packageInvalid: {part}: the package structure is not valid.
editor.save.finding.lossReportInvalid: The engine loss report is not in the expected format.
editor.save.finding.reopenMismatch: The reopened document differs from the edited document.
editor.save.finding.unsupported: {part}: preservation cannot be checked for this format or protected document.
editor.save.finding.preflightMissing: There is no preservation check result for this original.
editor.save.finding.previewStale: {part}: if the body changes, the original's preview is kept as is, and it cannot be confirmed that it holds no content from before editing.
editor.save.finding.referenceInvalid: {part}: the body refers to a character or paragraph shape that is not defined or is malformed (the editor may silently show a different shape).
document.pathLabel: Absolute path of the document to open
document.discard.reloadTitle: Discard edits to {name} and reload from the file?
document.discard.windowTitle: Discard edits in all documents and quit?
document.discard.windowBody: Some documents have unsaved changes. Quitting discards edits in all documents. Recovery is not available yet.
document.discard.body: This document has unsaved edits. Continuing permanently discards them. The original file is not changed.
document.discardedReloaded: Discarded edits to {name} and reloaded it from the file.
document.error.InvalidPath: The path is not valid. Enter an absolute path.
document.error.ExtensionMismatch: The file extension does not match the actual format.
document.error.Encrypted: Encrypted or DRM-protected documents cannot be opened.
document.error.ResourceLimit: The document exceeds a processing limit.
document.error.InvalidState: The document is not in a state that allows this action.
document.error.RevisionMismatch: The edit history diverged, so editing was stopped.
document.error.StaleLoad: A newer load of this document exists, so editing here was stopped.
document.error.FileChanged: The file changed after it was identified. Open it again.
document.error.UnsafeSave: Not saved: there is no evidence that the original content would be preserved.
document.error.SaveUnsupported: Not saved: the original cannot be replaced safely in this environment or for this file.
document.error.FileConflict: Not saved: the file changed after it was opened (external change); it was not overwritten.
document.error.SaveInProgress: A save is already in progress.
document.error.SaveNotReady: The document cannot be saved right now.
document.error.EngineFailure: The editing engine reported an error.
document.error.UnpreservedChanges: Not done because there are unsaved edits.
document.error.RenderLimit: The document's pages are too large or too many to draw within the display memory limit (the document is not damaged).
